instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to calculate the mean temperature last week.

atoms.a: First, add up all the temperatures together.
Now, divide the sum of the temperatures by the number of days.

end.text: The mean temperature last week was 26 °C.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to calculate the mean number of goals this season.

atoms.a: First, add up all the goals together.
Now, divide the sum of the goals by the number of teams.

end.text: The mean number of goals this season is 160.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to calculate the missing number.

atoms.a:
The mean height is 200 and there are 5 attempts.
First, find the total of the heights.

hint.text: If Mean = Total ÷ Amount, then Total = Mean × Amount
hint.sound: If the mean is the total of the numbers divided by the amount of numbers, then the total is the mean multiplied by the amount of numbers.

atoms.a: Next, find the total of the heights so far.
To find the missing number, subtract the total height from the added heights.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to calculate the missing number.

atoms.a:
The mean is 6 and there are 5 rows.
First find the total of the shoe size numbers.

hint.text: If Mean = Total ÷ Amount, then Total = Mean × Amount
hint.sound: If the mean is the total of the numbers divided by the amount of numbers, then the total is the mean multiplied by the amount of numbers.

atoms.a: Next, find the total of the shoe sizes so far.
To find the missing number, subtract the total of shoe sizes from the shoe sizes so far.
